rules.repro:
python3 - <<'PY'
import shopkit.billing as b
calls = []
original = b.charge_card
b.charge_card = lambda order: (calls.append(order), original(order))[1]
try:
    b.charge_order({"items": [], "total_cents": 500})
except b.BillingError:
    pass
raise SystemExit(1 if calls else 0)
PY
